text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm visiting a shrine with T.M. Opera O, 
but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"O God, I declare unto you! That I shall 
shine even brighter! And bestow the warmth 
of blessings upon all—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Therefore, bearing the aspirations of 
all creation upon my back, along this 
supreme path—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Hopefully this puts God in a 
better mood.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I've been so busy leading everyone 
as the "Supreme Ruler" that I haven't had 
the chance to visit God much.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...Troublesomely enough, once God gets 
into a sulk, He goes so far as to play 
pranks on my health just to get my 
attention."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However... if my own being is clouded, I 
cannot bring the ultimate radiance to 
everyone! That is why—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, worst possible timing.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! Did you come here to chat with me, 
too?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! ...I just came to look at 
the stars.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To conceal your true feelings before my 
sublime majesty... How utterly touching 
you are...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall answer those lovely feelings! With 
my brilliance that outshines even the 
stars!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Wait. Don't just go deciding things on 
your own—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*GLEEEAAAM*!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wh... what?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
W-What on earth was that light just 
now...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: My supreme presence, of course!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I-Impossible... Even if it were the moon, 
there's no way it could shine that 
bright...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! This is supreme radiance...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Was that light truly moonlight... or was 
it really her sheer presence...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, the shadow over her vanished, 
and she regained her supreme brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRAAAASH! Rumble...)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This is... the lamenting cry of God... It 
seems He wants to keep me all to Himself 
no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However—I am the "Supreme Overlord"! It is 
my duty to love all equally!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even if dark clouds loom over me... Even 
if my body collapses from poor form!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"O God! I shall speak to you as many times 
as it takes for you to understand...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems dark clouds still loom over 
T.M. Opera O's brilliance.
